title: R6 拉曼 Λ（同向）
derivation: Two-photon Rabi oscillation P₂ = (Ω_R²/Ω_eff²)sin²(Ω_eff t/2) (second-order Λ, light shifts compensated); scattering destroys the coherence (u). The exact static evolution is R0_R6_RAMAN_CO.

conditions.what: scattering per µs (mean of the two states)
axial ω·t at the end (orbit integration needed when not ≪ 1)
